subject: Mutual success playbook: MAP draft, timeline, and signature readiness
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@hypargo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (post-demo) — next steps

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the clarity on Hypargo's ingestion cadence and the two critical success metrics you called out (median generation latency < 350ms and monthly inference cost per 10k requests < $18). Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Scope: production inference for Hypargo web search assistant (initially English-US).
2) Success criteria: latency and cost targets above; integration of SSO + VPC; logging retention 90 days.
3) Proposed timeline (high level):
   - Week 0–2: Security questionnaire + SSO config
   - Week 3–6: Dedicated environment provisioning + smoke tests
   - Week 7: Canary run + signoff
   - Go-live target: Oct 15, 2026 (tentative)

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Success Playbook (MAP) that maps milestones, owners, and dependencies. Please review the responsibilities column in particular — we put Hypargo procurement and legal on the contract/PO milestone, and Redwood infra on provisioning.

Attachments: [Redwood_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (xlsx)]

Ask: can you confirm a target contract approval window (procurement/legal) and who on your side will own the SSO testing? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute MAP review with your technical owner this week.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa on delivery ops and Ben on pricing/discounting so we have all lanes covered.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

From: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@hypargo.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Roberto Santos <roberto.santos@hypargo.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (post-demo) — next steps

Thanks Vivek — great session.

Quick answers:
- Procurement/legal: we have an internal cutover window the week of Sep 20; legal will need final SOW + data processing appendix. I (Sophie) will be the exec sponsor and will shepherd approvals.
- SSO owner: Roberto will run the SSO testing on our side. Copying him here.

I'll take a look at the MAP and get back with any redlines by Friday (Sep 4). If it's helpful, we can do the MAP walkthrough on Sep 8 at 11:00am ET — Roberto, are you available then?

On Tue, 1 Sep 2026 at 14:20, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sophie,
>
> Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the clarity on Hypargo's ingestion cadence and the two critical success metrics you called out...

Best,
Sophie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@hypargo.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (post-demo) — MAP edits (security milestone)

Vivek — pulled the MAP and sketched a couple operational edits. High level: add a discrete security-review milestone and a short "post-canary QA sweep" before signoff. Proposed edits are inline on the attached MAP.

Key calls:
- Security questionnaire completion (Owner: Hypargo security) — dependency for Dedicated provisioning.
- Network test windows (Owner: Redwood infra; dependency: Hypargo SSO config) — we should reserve a 4-hour test window in week 4.
- Monitoring handover (Owner: Marissa) — ensure runbook + alert thresholds are agreed prior to go-live.

I've attached v1.1 with the changes: [Redwood_MAP_v1.1.xlsx] — please review and confirm we don't need to push go-live. My read: with timely legal sign-off the Oct 15 target is still achievable but contingent on procurement completing by Sep 24.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@hypargo.com>, Roberto Santos <roberto.santos@hypargo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP and signature readiness — action requested

Hi Sophie / Roberto,

Thanks for the quick turn on the MAP redlines, Marissa — attached is the consolidated MAP (v1.1) that reflects security milestone, the reserved test windows, and an updated responsibilities matrix. Highlights:

- Milestones and owners (short):
  * Security questionnaire complete — Owner: Hypargo security (Roberto) — target Sep 10 (COMPLETED)
  * Dedicated infra provisioned — Owner: Redwood infra — target Sep 22
  * Canary run (1k QPS) + QA sweep — Owner: Hypargo product + Redwood CS — target Sep 29
  * Contract signature / PO issued — Owner: Hypargo procurement — target Sep 24
  * Go-live (full production): Oct 15, 2026 — Owner: Hypargo product / Redwood infra

- Dependencies: legal SOW + DPA signed, VPC peering and SSO creds delivered, procurement PO for reserved capacity.

Attachments: [Redwood_MAP_v1.1.xlsx], [Signature_instructions.pdf]

Ask: please confirm by end of day today whether procurement will confirm PO by Sep 24 and whether your legal team needs any additional language in the DPA. If those items are green, I will send the DocuSign envelope for signature and we can lock in Oct 15 as go-live.

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/Hypargo-Redwood-MAP-18942
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-18942

Thanks — looping Ben for any pricing/discount confirmation.

—
Vivek

From: Sophie Trent <sophie.trent@hypargo.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Roberto Santos <roberto.santos@hypargo.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Updated MAP and signature readiness — action requested

Hi Vivek — all good on our side.

Roberto confirmed security questionnaire is complete and I just approved the SOW + DPA with our legal lead. Procurement has committed to issuing the PO by Sep 24 as requested; I'll follow up with a copy once it's routed. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign envelope — I will expedite signatures on my end.

Confirming Oct 15 as go-live target. Looking forward to the canary run notes.
